description: Integrated terminal tabs: the user's shell in a pty, rendered by xterm.js.

commands.title: Split terminal into a new group

terminal.fixWithAgent.description: Offer "Fix with agent" on a failed command: a small button when hovering its line, and in its dot's menu.

enumDescriptions: A short, quiet tone from the IDE
terminal.bell.description: What happens when a program rings the bell (\a).

terminal.sendKeybindingsToShell.description: Ctrl+<letter> keys go to the shell even at the prompt, instead of the IDE's shortcuts. While a program runs in the terminal (Claude Code, nano, vim, tmux) they always go to it.
terminal.sendKeybindingsToShell.title: Send keybindings to shell

terminal.scrollbarSize.description: Width of the terminal's scrollbar in pixels.

terminal.shellIntegration.enabled.description: Load shell integration in bash, zsh, fish and PowerShell (command marks in the gutter, command history for agents, the folder in the tab title). Applies to new terminals.

terminal.highlightCommands.description: Color the commands you run (program, flags, strings, variables, paths) with the editor theme's colors.

terminal.notifyAfterSeconds.description: When a command that ran at least this long finishes while the window is in the background, show a notification (0: never). Needs shell integration.

terminal.fontFamily.description: Font family (empty: the editor's monospace font).

terminal.lineHeight.description: Line height, as a multiple of the font size.

terminal.scrollback.description: Lines kept above the screen per terminal. Large values use more memory.

terminal.minimumContrastRatio.description: Text colors are adjusted to at least this contrast with their background, so colored output stays readable (like VS Code's terminal.integrated.minimumContrastRatio). 1: colors exactly as the program sends them; 4.5: readable text (the default); 7: high contrast.

enumDescriptions: Copy the selection, or paste when nothing is selected (Windows Terminal, PuTTY)
terminal.rightClickBehavior.description: What right-clicking in a terminal does.

enumDescriptions: Follow the tab's shape: side by side in a wide tab, stacked in a tall one
terminal.splitDirection.title: Split direction
terminal.splitDirection.description: How a split terminal tab lays out its terminals.

terminal.copyOnSelection.description: Copy text to the clipboard as soon as it's selected.

terminal.profiles.windows.title: Profiles (Windows)
terminal.profiles.windows.description: Terminal profiles on Windows, as in VS Code's terminal.integrated.profiles.windows: { "name": { "path": "C:\\…\\bash.exe" (or a list, the first that exists), "source": "PowerShell" | "Git Bash", "args": [], "env": { "NAME": "value" | null }, "icon": "terminal", "color": "terminal.ansiGreen", "overrideName": true } }. The shells found on this machine (PowerShell, Windows PowerShell, Git Bash, Command Prompt, WSL distributions) are listed too; null hides one of them, an entry of the same name changes it. A folder's settings may set it once the folder is trusted.

terminal.profiles.osx.title: Profiles (macOS)
terminal.profiles.osx.description: Terminal profiles on macOS (VS Code's terminal.integrated.profiles.osx): { "name": { "path": "/opt/homebrew/bin/fish", "args": ["-l"], "env": {}, "icon": "terminal", "color": "terminal.ansiBlue" } }. The shells in /etc/shells are listed too; null hides one. A folder's settings may set it once the folder is trusted.

terminal.profiles.linux.title: Profiles (Linux)
terminal.profiles.linux.description: Terminal profiles on Linux (VS Code's terminal.integrated.profiles.linux): { "name": { "path": "/usr/bin/fish", "args": ["-l"], "env": {}, "icon": "terminal", "color": "terminal.ansiBlue" } }. The shells in /etc/shells are listed too; null hides one. A folder's settings may set it once the folder is trusted.

terminal.defaultProfile.windows.title: Default profile (Windows)
terminal.defaultProfile.windows.description: The profile new terminals start with on Windows, by name ("Git Bash", "Command Prompt", "Ubuntu (WSL)"…). Empty: PowerShell 7 if installed, else Windows PowerShell. Also "Select default profile" in the terminal's + ▾ menu.

terminal.defaultProfile.osx.title: Default profile (macOS)
terminal.defaultProfile.osx.description: The profile new terminals start with on macOS, by name ("zsh", "fish"…). Empty: your login shell.

terminal.defaultProfile.linux.title: Default profile (Linux)
terminal.defaultProfile.linux.description: The profile new terminals start with on Linux, by name ("bash", "zsh", "fish"…). Empty: your login shell.

terminal.automationProfile.windows.title: Automation profile (Windows)
terminal.automationProfile.windows.description: The shell tasks and debug launches run their command lines in on Windows (VS Code's terminal.integrated.automationProfile.windows): { "path": "C:\\Program Files\\Git\\bin\\bash.exe", "args": [] }, with "env" for extra variables. Empty: the default shell. The flags that run one command (-c, -Command, /c) are added. A folder's settings may set it once the folder is trusted.

terminal.automationProfile.osx.title: Automation profile (macOS)
terminal.automationProfile.osx.description: The shell tasks and debug launches run their command lines in on macOS (VS Code's terminal.integrated.automationProfile.osx): { "path": "/bin/zsh", "args": [] }, with "env" for extra variables. Empty: the default shell. The flags that run one command (-c, -Command, /c) are added. A folder's settings may set it once the folder is trusted.

terminal.automationProfile.linux.title: Automation profile (Linux)
terminal.automationProfile.linux.description: The shell tasks and debug launches run their command lines in on Linux (VS Code's terminal.integrated.automationProfile.linux): { "path": "/bin/bash", "args": [] }, with "env" for extra variables. Empty: the default shell. The flags that run one command (-c, -Command, /c) are added. A folder's settings may set it once the folder is trusted.

terminal.enablePersistentSessions.title: Enable persistent sessions
terminal.enablePersistentSessions.description: Bring terminals back after a reload or restart. After Developer: Reload window the processes keep running and the terminals (hidden ones too) take them back with their output. After a restart each terminal's last output comes back dim above a new shell, under a "Restored session" line.

terminal.persistentSessionScrollback.title: Persistent session scrollback
terminal.persistentSessionScrollback.description: How many lines of each terminal's output are kept for the next session (0: none).

terminal.suggest.enabled.title: Suggestions
terminal.suggest.enabled.description: Suggest commands while typing at the prompt: programs on PATH, shell builtins, commands run before, files and folders, git subcommands and branches. Tab accepts; Enter accepts after moving with ↑ / ↓; Escape closes; Ctrl+Space opens them. Needs shell integration (bash, zsh, fish, PowerShell). Not an AI feature.

enumDescriptions: WebGL, and the DOM renderer for the rest of the session once WebGL fails
terminal.gpuAcceleration.title: GPU acceleration
terminal.gpuAcceleration.description: Draw terminals with WebGL (faster with lots of output) or the DOM renderer. A lost WebGL context falls back to the DOM renderer at once.

terminal.multiLinePasteWarning.description: Ask before pasting several lines into a program that would run each one (when it didn't ask for bracketed paste).
